description: This file defines a custom CookieAuthenticationEvents class that overrides the ValidatePrincipal method to revoke user authentication based on cache entries.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: A custom authentication event handler that revokes user sessions based on cache validation.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Validates the user's principal and revokes access if a revoke key is present in cache.
